results.title: GetApp - Products, Competitors, Financials, Employees, Headquarters Locations
highlights:
GetApp focused on providing software recommendations and insights for small businesses within the technology sector. Its main offerings include a recommendation engine and tailored insights that assist SMBs in making informed software purchasing decisions. It serves various sectors including business intelligence, collaboration tools, CRM, finance and accounting, HR management, integration solutions, marketing, and project management. It was founded in 2010 and is based in Barcelona, Spain. In January 2026, GetApp was acquired by G2.

CHICAGO, Jan. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- G2, the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace, today announced it has formally agreed to acquire the software discovery and recommendation platforms Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from Gartner, INC. (NYSE: IT).
...
The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

highlights:
G2 acquires Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice from Gartner. We break down what this consolidation means for B2B software vendors, pricing implications, and what to watch.

- They're promising "unified taxonomy," "pay-per-lead," and AI recommendations
- For vendors: this is interesting... but probably not good news
- When there's only one place to be found, the stakes get higher (and so do the prices)
